title: MongoDB Atlas Live Connectivity - mongodb_connected=false (TLS handshake alert on Windows; local fallback active)
description: Test ENV-002 failed during verification of MongoDB Atlas Live Connectivity.
actual: mongodb_connected=false (TLS handshake alert on Windows; local fallback active)
root_cause: MongoDB Atlas cluster requires specific SSL/TLS cipher or IP whitelist for Windows OpenSSL environment.
evidence: MongoDB Atlas reported SSL: TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR during startup
recommended_fix: Check MongoDB Atlas IP access list and TLS version parameters in MONGODB_URI.
